name: memory-bank
description: Keep shared, git-tracked project context in a memory-bank/ folder of Markdown files, loaded at session start and kept current with gentle reminders.

reminder_mode.title: Reminder mode
reminder_mode.description: How to remind about an out-of-date memory bank: nudge (tell you once, never block), strict (block Claude once so it updates the bank), or off.

min_changed_files.title: Minimum changed files
min_changed_files.description: How many project files must change after the last memory bank update before a reminder appears.

load_mode.title: Session start loading
load_mode.description: What to load into context at session start: summary (up to 2,000 characters), pointer (one line), or off.
